description: Java client library for the Frontal API, with a shared OkHttp transport, Jackson models, service clients, and streaming.
rules: Use contracts/sdk-endpoints.json and contracts/openapi as the source of truth for endpoint methods and paths.
The published facade is dev.frontal:frontal-sdk, and production classes use the dev.frontal.sdk package.
The SDK targets Java 17 and uses OkHttp for transport and Jackson for JSON.
Keep service resource types under resources/ and do not create Java subpackages.
Java does not load .env files automatically.
